# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Independent, private document concierge based in St. Catherine, Jamaica. We pre-audit paperwork against each agency's counter rules and file or collect documents at PICA, TAJ, RGD, JCF and ITA for clients in Jamaica and overseas (US, UK, Canada). We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with the Government of Jamaica. Government fees are paid to the agency and are separate from our concierge retainer.

Contact: WhatsApp +1 (876) 561-2614 (https://wa.me/18765612614), info@documenthelpja.com. Requirements and fees on this site were last checked September 2026.

## Services (Dedicated Pages)

- [Jamaican Passport Services](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-renewal.html): Adult renewals, name changes, minor renewals, lost/stolen replacements, and first-time applications.
- [Citizenship by Descent Application](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-application.html): PICA document pre-audit and filing for diaspora applicants.
- [TRN Application for Diaspora & Non-Nationals](https://documenthelpja.com/trn-application.html): Overseas proxy lodgment at TAJ with notarised foreign ID, optional Apostille, and DHL shipping ($70 USD retainer).
- [Driver's Licence Renewal Prep & Pre-Pay](https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html): Online TAJ fee pre-payment, form preparation, and traffic ticket clearance (JMD $5,000 retainer).
- [Motor Vehicle Licence Renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence.html): Two-stop fitness, insurance validation, and registration pre-payment.
- [Driving Abstracts & History Verification](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-driving-abstract.html): ITA driving record retrieval for overseas licensing and insurance validation ($100 USD retainer).
- [Police Records & Clearance Certificates](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html): Local fingerprint scheduling and overseas JCF submission with optional Apostille.
- [Birth, Marriage & Death Certificates (RGD)](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-rgd-certificates.html): Official RGD copy retrievals, registry searches, and late registrations.
- [Digital Business Contact Card](https://documenthelpja.com/card.html): Instant vCard download and WhatsApp connection.
